mostWorthwhile.text: Building the triceps was most worthwhile: comparing its pull behind the elbow with the biceps' pull in front made their different jobs clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral to the back bone felt repetitive after doing the same thing on the front, though it completed the model.

surprise.text: The same kind of muscle cells can have different effects because of where the muscles attach and pull.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless. The mineral fittings had a stated purpose, although I followed the named pairing without knowing exactly how mineral fits into bone beforehand.

continue.text: I might continue to see how other body parts work together. The muscle comparison was interesting, though the repeated mineral step was less engaging.
